crossRefs.note: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?
Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.
How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?
Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was…
‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.
For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right:
If they sin against you (for there is no man who doesn’t sin), and you are angry with them, and deliver them to the…
If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.
Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of…

translations.web: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?
translations.bsb: “Yes, I know that it is so, but how can a mortal be righteous before God?
translations.kjv: I know it is so of a truth: but how should man be just with God?
translations.asv: Of a truth I know that it is so: But how can man be just with God?
